channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: TSE: Kássio Nunes autoriza pronunciamento de Lula neste domingo sobre o 7 de setembro
item.description: The president of the TSE, Kássio Nunes Marques, authorized President Lula's speech about September 7th, which will air on Sunday night, the 6th.

item.title: Clima de apreensão toma conta da campanha de Lula
item.description: Lula's campaign is marked by anxiety amid strong anti-petism and high rejection rates. Despite announcing R$200 billion in measures, his approval does not rise in polls, unlike the historical trend for incumbent candidates. He also struggles to dominate the media narrative and set a proactive agenda.

item.title: Crise STF: 'problemas reais e graves estão sendo misturados com intereses eleitorais', diz Flávio Dino em postagem
item.description: Minister Flávio Dino criticized the crisis at the STF, emphasizing that real issues are being confused with electoral interests. He supported ending old investigations, such as the fake news inquiry, and questioned the need to archive them before the statute of limitations.

item.title: Senado banca segurança de Flávio em campanha, mas mantém gastos em sigilo
item.description: The Brazilian Senate keeps spending on Flávio Bolsonaro's security detail secret, despite having spent around R$ 7.4 million on protections through August 2026 — over three times the total in 2022. The Senate also refused information requests under the Freedom of Information Law. Officers attribute the increase mainly to protecting Flávio and, to a lesser extent, other candidates like Sergio Moro.

item.title: Em carreata, Arruda promete construir feira definitiva do Itapoã e Paranoá
item.description: DF gubernatorial candidate José Roberto Arruda (PSD) pledged, during a caravan through Itapoã and Paranoá, to build a permanent fair, implement a BRT connecting the areas to the Pilot Plan, and improve health, security, and education. His candidacy remains suspended as the TSE reviews the appeal against the TRE-DF ruling that blocked his registration.

item.title: Pressão da inadimplência sobre BB sobe; banco é o mais afetado
item.description: Loan defaults at Banco do Brasil rose to 5.6% in Q2 2026, driven by agribusiness and retail segments, raising analyst concerns over profit sustainability. The credit portfolio deterioration coincides with electoral uncertainties, heightening political risk for the state-controlled bank.

item.title: As perguntas sobre Flávio Bolsonaro que aumentaram a desconfiança de Mendonça com a PF
item.description: During a Federal Police operation, agents repeatedly asked about documents related to senator Flávio Bolsonaro, despite his name not being in the search warrant. This reinforced Minister André Mendonça's suspicions that PF leadership was shielding investigations involving President Lula.

item.title: Se eleito, Flávio Bolsonaro pode governar com o STF de Jair
item.description: If elected in 2026, Flávio Bolsonaro will govern with a restructured Supreme Court, following the departure of ministers such as Edson Fachin and Alexandre de Moraes, creating room for justices appointed by his father, Jair Bolsonaro. The scenario also involves internal tensions within the PL, with efforts to downplay Cláudio Castro's image in Rio de Janeiro. The dynamics of the STF and local alliances will be crucial for the governability of the new president.

item.title: Taekwondo: Maria Clara Pacheco conquista ouro no Grand Prix Series Muju
item.description: Maria Clara Pacheco won gold in the under-57 kg category at the Grand Prix Series Muju in South Korea, defeating South Korean Yu Jin Kim 2-0. Henrique Marques took bronze in the 80 kg division, and Milena Titoneli finished 5th. Brazil stood out in international taekwondo.

item.title: Lula e Flávio: veja a agenda dos presidenciáveis no 7 de Setembro
item.description: On Brazil's Independence Day (September 7th), presidential candidates Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro will hold separate events less than a month before the first round of the 2026 elections. Lula will attend the official military-civic parade in Brasília and deliver a national address, while Flávio Bolsonaro will lead a political rally on Avenida Paulista criticizing the government and Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes. Augusto Cury will also campaign in Rio de Janeiro with a walk in Copacabana.

item.title: Palmeiras visita o Botafogo tentando manter a liderança do Brasileirão
item.description: Palmeiras faces Botafogo in the 26th round of the Brazilian Championship at 6:30 PM at Nilton Santos Stadium, aiming to maintain the lead. Struggling with poor form, Botafogo seeks recovery after Copa Sudamericana elimination.

item.title: Dorival confirma força máxima do São Paulo contra o Boca Juniors após vitória sobre o Atlético-MG
item.description: Dorival Junior confirmed that São Paulo will field a full-strength squad against Boca Juniors in the Copa Sudamericana following their victory over Atlético-MG in the Brazilian Championship. The coach explained the absence of Calleri, who is recovering, and emphasized the importance of the match in Argentina.

item.title: Augusto Cury tem apoio de aliados de Marçal e tropa de influenciadores despolitizados no Instagram
item.description: Augusto Cury (Avante) gained momentum on social media with the support of at least 40 micro-influencers who don't usually discuss politics, as well as allies of coach Pablo Marçal (PRTB). Between August 26 and 28, his Instagram followers jumped from 8.4 million to 10.7 million, reflected in polls that placed him in third place with up to 11% of voting intentions.

item.title: Caiado diz que Lula e Flávio "têm muito a explicar" sobre investigações
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) stated that Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, the leaders in 2026 polls, have 'a lot to explain' regarding investigations involving their campaigns' inner circles. He believes the damage to both rivals could carry him into the runoff, despite polling at just 4% in Datafolha, behind Augusto Cury (8%).

item.title: Zema mira Moraes, Gonet e Vorcaro em novo vídeo; assista
item.description: Presidential candidate Romeu Zema (Novo) released a new episode of his AI-generated animated series 'Os Intocáveis', mocking Supreme Court justices Alexandre de Moraes, Dias Toffoli, and Gilmar Mendes, along with Prosecutor-General Paulo Gonet and banker Daniel Vorcaro. The video links them to corruption suspicions and the Banco Master case, sparking controversy and prompting legal reactions, including a lawsuit filed by Justice Gilmar Mendes.

item.title: Empresas não declaradas ao TSE são inexpressivas, diz campanha de Cury
item.description: Augusto Cury's (Avante) campaign stated that the three companies not declared to the TSE are insignificant or inactive, with no relevant income. The candidate, one of the wealthiest in the race with R$ 242.3 million declared, acknowledged possible inconsistencies and said he will correct them. A Folha de S.Paulo report revealed omissions of companies both in Florida and in Brazil.

item.title: Na véspera do 7 de setembro, Lula se contrapõe a Flávio e faz aceno sobre soberania
item.description: On the eve of Brazil's September 7th Independence Day, President Lula released a campaign video attacking Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, accusing him of subservience to Trump and defending national sovereignty and the Pix payment system. The material contrasts Flávio's statements about the tariffs with Lula's declarations calling critics 'traitors,' using images of Flávio alongside Milei and Netanyahu as backdrop. A Bolsonaro-aligned rally on Avenida Paulista and the 8th anniversary of the knife attack on Jair Bolsonaro also mark the holiday's eve.

item.title: Carreata de Douglas Ruas na Zona Oeste tem faixa pedindo 'fora Moraes'
item.description: State deputy Douglas Ruas (PL), candidate for Governor of Rio de Janeiro, held a campaign rally in Padre Miguel on Sunday featuring a banner reading 'Out with Moraes,' amid the Supreme Court crisis over the Master case. During the event, Ruas asked for votes for Flávio Bolsonaro in the presidential race and championed his 'Rio Real' slogan focused on security improvements and workers' welfare. According to Quaest polling, he has 19% of voting intentions, trailing Eduardo Paes, who leads with 37%.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro cobra voto de Cármen Lúcia para abertura de investigação contra Moraes
item.description: Flavio Bolsonaro urged Justice Cármen Lúcia to vote for an investigation against Alexandre de Moraes at the STF, tying her vote to her democratic record and rallying supporters for September 7. Tensions rose after messages between Moraes and Daniel Vorcaro were disclosed by André Mendonça, prompting Moraes to retaliate via the fake news inquiry.

item.title: Na véspera do 7 de Setembro, candidatos a presidente usam redes e participam de atos públicos para mobilizar eleitores
item.description: On the eve of September 7, presidential candidates used social media and public events to mobilize voters. Lula posted a video contrasting Bolsonaro sons' remarks on the U.S. with defense of Pix and national sovereignty; Flávio Bolsonaro recalled the 2018 stabbing and attacked Lula and Moraes. Renan Santos and Ronaldo Caiado held in-person events; Augusto Cury and Romeu Zema had no public agenda.

item.title: Roda-gigante, espaço kids e feira de produtores: Rio Gastronomia 2026 reúne atrações além da boa comida
item.description: Rio Gastronomia 2026, running from September 17 to October 4 at the Jockey Club Brasileiro, features signature dishes from starred chefs, performances by artists such as Samuel Rosa and D2, an illuminated Ferris wheel, a kids' area, and a producers' fair with artisanal foods. The event brings together family-friendly attractions and diverse culinary experiences.

item.title: A contabilidade dos ministros do STF sobre o próprio impeachment
item.description: STF justice projects 42 pro-impeachment votes if process against colleague moves forward in 2027, despite new two-thirds quorum. Relationships between minister and banker generate scandal with compromising messages.

item.title: O vendedor de sonhos comprou um pesadelo de R$ 31,5 milhões
item.description: Writer Augusto Cury, a presidential candidate, declared assets worth nearly R$250 million and holds a R$31.5 million receivable from Fictor, a company facing financial difficulties after acquiring Banco Master. The case was investigated by José Roberto de Toledo on A Hora, aired by Canal UOL.

item.title: Flávio pede que Cármen Lúcia apoie investigação sobre Moraes
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro urged Minister Carmen Lúcia to support the investigation into Alexandre de Moraes during a live social media broadcast. He expressed hope that the minister would vote in favor of investigating the colleague.

item.title: Lula apoia 50 candidatos ao Senado; 18 são competitivos
item.description: President Lula supports 50 Senate candidates, 18 of whom are deemed competitive. The strategy aims to strengthen the government's majority in Congress. Senate composition also affects relations with the Supreme Court.

item.title: Saiba quem são os candidatos ao Senado apoiados por Lula em 2026
item.description: Lula supports 50 Senate candidates in 2026, with 18 among the most competitive. The support aims to strengthen the congressional majority and facilitate project approvals. Parties like PT and MDB lead the list of supported candidates.

item.title: Cuidado: você pode estar debatendo política com um robô criado por IA
item.description: A survey reveals that 24% of analyzed social media accounts during election period may be 'neurobots' - AI robots creating fake characters to influence voters, with highest contamination rate in PL Nacional (34%) and lowest in Augusto Cury (14%).

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro cobra Cármen Lúcia por investigação contra Moraes: ‘Vai ficar muito ruim para sua biografia’
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro pressured Minister Cármen Lúcia to support investigating Alexandre de Moraes, threatening her biography. He defended Moraes' departure from the STF and emphasized that the law must apply to everyone. The Court will analyze decisions by Moraes and Mendonça amid an internal crisis.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro publica mensagem de apoio a Mendonça em meio a crise no STF: 'ungido do Senhor'
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro publicly supported Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça on Instagram amid a crisis at the STF stemming from a dispute with Justice Alexandre de Moraes in the Master case. She emphasized divine visions regarding Mendonça's career, calling him 'chosen,' while the Court considers a potential vote on the matter.

item.title: Michelle chama Mendonça de ‘ungido do Senhor’ em meio a crise no STF
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro referred to Minister André Mendonça as 'unguided by the Lord' in an Instagram post, recalling her support for his appointment to the STF. The crisis in the Court intensified after Mendonça ordered a report on relationships between banker Daniel Vorcaro and Alexandre de Moraes, sparking controversies over functional prerogatives.

item.title: Lula defende IA em português para reduzir dependência externa
item.description: Lula advocates for Portuguese-language AI to reduce foreign dependence, highlighting the PBIA and $23 billion investments. He also emphasized the gov.br expansion and Redata approval, which could attract data centers.

item.title: Bolsonaro pede a Moraes autorização para receber visita do irmão
item.description: Former president Jair Bolsonaro requested authorization from Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes to receive a visit from his brother Renato Bolsonaro, who is a pre-candidate for federal deputy. Visits to the former president are restricted to children, lawyers and medical staff, with specific suspension for Flávio Bolsonaro. Renato declared assets worth R$ 268,000 to the Electoral Court, including investments at Banco do Brasil and Bradesco.

item.title: “Binho”: o apelido dado a Lulinha por empresário que se deu bem no governo
item.description: Investigations reveal that Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, son of President Lula, was nicknamed 'Binho' by businessmen he closely interacted with. Companies linked to these relationships, such as MChecon Design, saw an explosive increase in federal contracts after 2023, with revenue rising from R$197,000 to R$63 million.

item.title: Torcidas organizadas de clubes brasileiros apoiam ao menos 13 candidatos nas eleições
item.description: Brazilian fan groups have backed at least 13 candidates in the 2026 elections, also influencing local and party politics. Their support spans state, district, and federal races, excluding the presidential contest. This reflects the growing political engagement of fan organizations beyond football.

item.title: Crise no STF fez Lula ter semana atípica no Planalto
item.description: The crisis at the STF, triggered by the leak of Daniel Vorcaro's messages, led President Lula to change his behavior, avoiding meetings at the Planalto and opting for the Alvorada Palace to prevent further leaks. After listening to Supreme Court ministers and PT allies, Lula adopted a stance defending the investigations, stating that no one is above the law. This strategy aims to mitigate the electoral wear caused by corruption revelations.

item.title: Senador Marcos Pontes é alvo de queixas por se engajar pouco em campanha
item.description: Senator Marcos Pontes (PL) faces backlash for skipping campaign events organized by Tarcísio de Freitas' slate (Republicanos) in São Paulo. Members of the slate deem his absence harmful to the campaign, highlighting internal tensions among political allies during the state election.

item.title: Pesquisas eleitorais mostram a distância entre Lula e Flávio após números da semana
item.description: Recent polls indicate Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) leads in the first round with a 5 to 9.7 percentage point advantage over Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). However, in a potential runoff, both candidates are technically tied according to most polling firms. Augusto Cury (Avante) positions himself as the third option with support ranging from 7.8% to 11%.

item.title: O sinal amarelo para Lula a 30 dias das eleições
item.description: With less than 30 days before the election, Lula is experiencing a decline in popularity according to polls, including data from his own PT campaign. The president is going through his worst approval moment in the last 12 months.

item.title: Bia Ferreira esbanja vigor musical em álbum conceituado na ‘amefricanidade’
item.description: Bia Ferreira releases her third album, 'Améfrica', rooted in afrocentricity and blending Afro-Brazilian and Caribbean rhythms. The album reflects her artistic rise from the streets to international stages, maintaining a strong political and cultural stance.

item.title: Michelle chama Mendonça de 'ungido do Senhor' em meio a crise no STF
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro criticized Alexandre de Moraes and defended Supreme Court minister André Mendonça, calling Moraes 'the Lord's unguided one' during the institutional crisis. The post sparked reactions in national politics.

item.title: Justiça Eleitoral vai avaliar percepção do eleitorado sobre pleito
item.description: The Electoral Justice established a working group to assess voter perception regarding the 2026 elections, aiming to promote transparency and improve the electoral process. The group will be coordinated by the TSE and is expected to deliver a report by March 2027.

item.title: Presente em jantar com Lula, Rubens Ometto doa R$ 2 milhões ao PT
item.description: Rubens Ometto, after attending Lula's dinner at Alvorada Palace, donated R$2 million to the PT for the re-election campaign. The donation took place in the context of an event that gathered 16 major entrepreneurs and bankers.

item.title: Botafogo x Palmeiras opõe crise e liderança no Brasileirão; veja odds
item.description: Botafogo is facing a crisis in the Brazilian Championship, with three consecutive losses, and hosts the leader Palmeiras at Nilton Santos. Fans protested at the training center, increasing pressure on the team. The odds show Palmeiras as the favorite (2.10), followed by a draw (3.40) and Botafogo (3.35).

item.title: Modelo de gasto público e consumo turbinados do governo Lula já provoca ressaca econômica
item.description: President Lula's administration continues stimulus policies and tax waivers, yet the economy grapples with high interest rates, rising debt and record defaults. Both businesses and households struggle with loan costs, prompting expert warnings of a potential downturn.

item.title: 4 lances do terremoto institucional: Fachin, aviso de Lula, prece e Kassab
item.description: The clash between Supreme Court justices triggered an institutional crisis involving President Lula and figures such as Fachin, Mendonça, and Kassab, with allegations of bribes and selective leaks. Internal tension within the judiciary heightened concerns over the Justice's image and governance in the country.

item.title: Só vale o real: como vão funcionar as regras do TSE para uso de IA nas eleições
item.description: The TSE set rules for AI use in campaigns, banning deepfakes and avatars with high realism. The controversy involved a Bolsonaro avatar used at PL's convention, not deemed early campaigning. The new ruling aims to prevent manipulation of real or fictional individuals' images and voices.

item.title: Motta e Alcolumbre confirmam presença no 7 de Setembro de Lula
item.description: The presidents of the Chamber, Hugo Motta (Republicanos-PB), and the Senate, Davi Alcolumbre (União Brasil-AP), confirmed their attendance at the 7 de Setembro civic parade in Brasília. Both are running for re-election: Motta for the Chamber and Alcolumbre for the Senate, while also lobbying support to remain as speaker next year.

item.title: Saiba como se proteger de golpes que usam nome da Justiça Eleitoral
item.description: Fake messages using the name of the Electoral Justice may trick voters by requesting payments or personal data. To protect yourself, check any pending issues through the official TSE Portal, Self-Service platform, or e-Título app. Never trust links or information sent via WhatsApp or email without prior verification.

item.title: Petistas veem "vantagem" em votar PEC 6x1 somente após o 1º turno
item.description: Despite public criticism from Lula, a wing of the PT sees an advantage in voting the PEC 6×1 only after the first round, believing it provides more time to position the issue as an electoral strategy. Davi Alcolumbre's decision to postpone the vote was interpreted as a tactical move that may favor Lula and complicate the Bolsonarists' campaign.

item.title: Frase do dia
item.description: Lula argues that candidates should be judged by their past record, not just future promises. He stresses the importance of knowing the history of those running to understand what they have actually done. The statement criticizes political superficiality and advocates analyzing each candidate's track record.
